# NetProfit
NetProfit is a professional platform for Tax, Legal & Business Registration in India.

## Services
We offer services such as:
- [Company Registration (Pvt Ltd)](https://netprofit.in/services/private-limited-company)
- [LLP Registration](https://netprofit.in/services/limited-liability-partnership)
- [OPC Registration](https://netprofit.in/services/opc-registration)
- [Nidhi Company](https://netprofit.in/services/nidhi-company)
- [GST Registration](https://netprofit.in/services/gst-registration)
- [GST Return Filing](https://netprofit.in/services/gst-return)
- [Income Tax Return Filing](https://netprofit.in/services/income-tax-return)
- [TDS Return Filing](https://netprofit.in/services/tds-return)
- [PF & ESIC Return](https://netprofit.in/services/pf-return)
- [MSME / Udyam Registration](https://netprofit.in/services/msme-registration)
- [FSSAI License](https://netprofit.in/services/fssai-license)
- [Trade License](https://netprofit.in/services/trade-license)
- [Trademark Registration](https://netprofit.in/services/trademark)
